candidates.sentence: I will oppose new taxes and the reckless spending that has fueled inflation and caused our cost of living to soar.
I will work to end the chaos on the southern border and approve new border security measures.

It is painfully obvious that the policies coming out of Sacramento, like the gas tax increase and Newsom’s short-sighted attempt to limit California’s energy production, will only contribute to more expensive energy and make us more dependent on unreliable sources.
Kamala Harris’ plan to give away trillions in government handouts will inflate our national debt and weaken the economy.
